channels.name: AP / AN
channels.description: Differential twisted-pair toward the next sub node; carries the downstream superframe + phantom power.

channels.name: BP / BN
channels.description: Differential twisted-pair toward the main node; carries the upstream superframe. Absent on the main node's master side.

channels.name: BCLK
channels.description: Local I2S/TDM bit clock, derived from the recovered bus clock.

channels.name: SYNC / FSYNC / WS
channels.description: Local I2S/TDM frame sync, derived from the bus clock.

channels.name: SDA / SCL
channels.description: Local I2C control port; tunneled over the bus for host register access.

channels.name: IO0..IO7 / GPIO
channels.description: General-purpose I/O; supports GPIO over distance.

channels.name: IRQ / INT
channels.description: Interrupt output toward the host (main node) / local.

channels.name: VIN / SWGND
channels.description: Bus-power input and downstream power-switch control for phantom power.

global_signals.name: Bus clock
global_signals.description: Generated by the main node; recovered and re-timed at each sub node.

global_signals.name: Superframe SYNC
global_signals.description: Per-sample-period synchronization preamble all nodes lock to.
